- Drawdown: credits will be applied monthly against usage; finance will receive a monthly drawdown statement showing tokens consumed and remaining balance.
- Reconciliation: quarterly statement; any overage above committed spend billed at list rates; unused prepay rolls into the following 12 months per the SOW (see attached stub).

2) Confirm the billing entity (Acme US Inc vs Acme Ltd) and PO number you want on the invoice.
3) Confirm payment method (wire/ACH).
